parts.t: Caulfeild is one of West Vancouver's most scenic and sought-after communities, featuring rocky shoreline access, ocean views, and prestigious homes set among towering firs. With Rockridge and Caulfeild Elementary schools nearby, and direct access to marine parks, it's a top choice for luxury buyers who want nature at their doorstep.
